events.title: Samsung Galaxy S22 released
events.summary: Samsung began selling the Samsung Galaxy S22 — smaller S22 brought flagship specs to a compact [Android] form factor.
events.about: The Galaxy S series remained [Android]'s volume flagship counterweight to iPhone. Smaller s22 brought flagship specs to a compact android form factor. Developers testing [Android] builds routinely validated on Galaxy S hardware as the default non-[Pixel] reference.

narrative.whyChosen: The Samsung Galaxy S22 continued Samsung's annual [Android] flagship cadence.
narrative.whyImportant: Galaxy S devices set the hardware bar millions of [Android] users and developers encounter.
narrative.problemSolved: [Android] needed consistent premium hardware for testing flagship features each year.

events.title: Meta loses $230 billion in market value in one day
events.summary: Meta Platforms stock plunged 26% on February 3, 2022 — wiping out roughly $230 billion in market capitalization after a weak earnings report and pivot costs toward the [metaverse].
events.about: It was the largest single-day value destruction for any U.S. company. Zuckerberg blamed Apple iOS privacy changes (ATT) for ad-targeting headwinds and doubled down on Reality Labs spending. The crash signaled that ad-dependent social platforms were vulnerable to privacy [regulation] and that '[metaverse]' bets were not convincing public markets.

narrative.whyChosen: Meta's one-day crash was the loudest market signal that privacy changes hurt ad-tech economics.
narrative.whyImportant: It validated Apple's ATT impact and cooled investor appetite for [metaverse] spending.
narrative.problemSolved: Markets repriced social ad businesses after iOS privacy limits reduced targeting precision.
